summary: Retest of iteration_2 fixes. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (15 existing incl. test_threshold_alarm_event_logged + 4 new command-validation tests: chamber 9/-1 -> 422, setpoint 'abc'/null -> 422). Frontend at 390x844: double click on chamber-1-sp-up adds 1.0 (22->23, then restored to 22); empty threshold + save shows sonner toast 'Enter valid numbers' with no page errors and thresholds unchanged; humidity and vent charts Y axis 0-100; EN shows Chamber 1/2/3 in chamber switch, chamber screen and settings cards with no 'Komora' anywhere, PL shows Komora 1/2/3; bottom nav switching, chamber tabs, values render, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). One new minor backend issue: a boolean setpoint value is accepted.

minor.issue: set_setpoint with value=true is accepted (200), because isinstance(True, int) is True in Python. The sim treats it as 1 and clamps it to 5.0°C (reproduced: chamber 1 setpoint became 5.0, now restored to 20). Fix: `isinstance(cmd.value, bool) or not isinstance(cmd.value, (int, float))` -> 422.

action_items: Reject boolean values for set_setpoint in device_command (bool is a subclass of int)
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsView pending setpoint ref resets on every ch.setpoint change. If the echo of click 1 arrives after click 2 was sent, click 3 builds on the echoed value and one step is lost. This is a rare edge case and acceptable for now.
Editing files under /app/backend/tests triggers uvicorn hot reload, which briefly disconnects MQTT; commands sent during the reload return 503
